integrity: All arguments and small computational checks are provided, with no claim of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: The classifications cover only exponent p^e and immediately succeeding exponent p^e+1, over finite fields of characteristic p. Group schemes over nonreduced bases and other exponents are not classified; mathematical priority is provisional. Finite computation is corroboration, not infinite proof.
title: An exact prime-power symmetry jump for modular monomial complete intersections
